title: Beckett Baseball Card Monthly November 1987 Issue #33 - Jorge Bell
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Price Guides & Publications
descriptionText: The Beckett Baseball Card Monthly November 1987 Issue #33 features baseball player Jorge Bell on its cover. As a vintage original magazine published by Beckett Media, this issue serves as a valuable collector's item for sports trading card enthusiasts. With a focus on baseball cards, this price guide provides insights and information on the world of sports trading cards, specifically highlighting the player Jorge Bell. Perfect for fans of vintage baseball memorabilia, this magazine offers a glimpse into the past of the sports trading card industry.
